newsitem.title: GERMANY: Firm N.Europe rapeseed prices deter buyers.
newsitem.headline: Firm N.Europe rapeseed prices deter buyers.

text.p: Northern European oilseeds traders and crushers are in retreat after taking some rapeseed in the past few days, brokers said on Thursday.
"Prices firmed on tightness and crop weather developments in the Americas, but also in line with the dollar," one said.
"With all these factors in flux, it's hard to predict the course of business -- sellers won't follow the market lower and buyers point to alternative seeds and unattractive margins."
Free Hamburg sellers of old crop rapeseed were at 475 marks a tonne, with buyers five marks lower, and new crop was offered at 440 marks free Hamburg versus 435 marks for buyers.
Rape oil demand was picking up as its premium over soyoil in Rotterdam markets narrowed, although buyers generally baulked at higher prices across the oil complex, brokers said.
The rape/soyoil premium stood at 0.50 guilders or even money on Thursday compared with one guilder a week ago and 1.75 guilders a fortnight ago.
Rape meal was also in demand because dollar firmness boosted prices of alternative imported protein feeds.
But latest meal price rises did not go down well with consumers in the compound feeds industry, who had bought sizeable replacement cover in the first half of January.
February rapeseed buyers' prices at points other than Hamburg were at 450-470 marks, little changed from Jan/Feb prices earlier this month.
But the new crop market, at 435-447 marks, compared with 415-439 marks quoted a fortnight ago.
The Matif futures market last showed Feb at 452 marks, May at 460 and Aug at 437.
Feb/April rape oil sellers were at 87.50 marks and May/July at 88.50.
Spot meal ex Hamburg mills was at 32.75 marks per 100 kg, Feb meal at 32.00 marks and March/April at 30.75.
